name: emotion.v1
description: Calibration cases for the deterministic session emotion/intent heuristic (Spec 2.4 AC-3). Synthetic texts only; measures false-confident inference and abstention.

cases.text: This is the third time the deploy pipeline failed this week. It is honestly ridiculous and I am fed up with it.
We need the board deck finished by Friday, this is urgent, please treat it as the deadline.
I am not sure whether we should hire now or wait. Maybe we revisit it next quarter, I think.
The launch went great and the team did a fantastic job. I love how it came together.
The vendor renewal is in October and covers twelve seats on the current plan.
Interesting idea from the offsite about pricing tiers for the mid-market segment.
Standup moved to nine thirty on Tuesdays. The sprint board has fourteen open tickets.
The launch went well and the team celebrated, though the metrics dashboard is late again and that is annoying.
